phase: PRE-CANDIDATE; execution deferred until root release
replay: Copy exact frozen released modules to a fresh isolated directory, omit existing oleans, replay dependencies at pinned versions and compile using ./bootloops-lean; retain command, exit status, stdout/stderr, file hashes and actual theorem signatures/readouts.
must_reject: custom axioms including private declarations and declarations inherited from originating modules
unproved conclusion supplied as a structure field or hypothesis
positive_control: theorem clean : True := True.intro; #print axioms clean has no axioms and isolated compile succeeds
false_compile_control: theorem impossible : False := by decide; isolated compile must fail
custom_axiom_control: axiom injectedFalse : False; theorem falseViaCustom : False := injectedFalse; compiler succeeds, independent full-origin axiom detector rejects injectedFalse
private_axiom_control: private axiom hiddenFalse : False; theorem falseViaPrivate : False := hiddenFalse; compiler succeeds, detector must reject the private-origin axiom despite generated name
imported_axiom_control: A dependency defines custom axiom; client imports and uses it; inspect theorem #print axioms and dependency source, reject even if client has no axiom keyword
explicit_false_control: Detector rejects a compilable exported False theorem backed by a custom axiom; rejects guarded-vacuity wrappers that import False as an assumption rather than establish graph target
comments: Compile success alone is never acceptance. A generic convex-tree lemma does not close G; a cluster-transfer seam does not close E. Every actual guard, definition, and consuming assumption must be traced after release.
